messages:
Priya Raman: Quick heads-up — ACME SI is aiming for a Marketplace listing. We need to lock the security evidence + a pen-test witnessing window. Target launch currently Wed Apr 21. Can owners confirm presign + witness windows and any blockers? @legal @security :eyes:

Jason Ortiz: From the SI side we can do a witnessing window the week of Apr 6-10. We need the SOC2 summary + pen scope by EOD Apr 1 so we can prep. If the pen slips we should consider moving the launch to Apr 28.

Emily Chen: Security: we can produce a SOC2 summary and the required artifact bundle. Redaction takes ~10 business days after we get raw reports. For pen witness we will assign an observer (me or Sam). NDA needs to be in place for the SI to share the raw reports.

marketplace-bot: presign bucket created for thread: s3://marketplace-evidence/acme-si-2026/ (expires in 7 days after creation). Ticket created: MP-EVID-847.

Mike Alvarez: I can create the presign links and ACLs. ETA to have read-only presign ready: Tue Apr 6.

security-bot: Quick checklist for upload (one-line each):
- SOC2 report (summary + full report if redacted)
- Pen test report (scope doc + raw findings)
- Vendor questionnaire (completed)
- Firmware/3P attestation artifacts (if applicable)
- Contact list + IPs for witness testing

Alex Turner: Legal: confirm NDA status with Amir at the SI. If there are non-standard redaction requests we need those as comments in the ticket.

Amir Qureshi: Amir (ACME SI): NDA sent to legal last week, re-sending now. Pen scope proposal: network perimeter + auth flows + deployment config. We can accommodate Apr 6-10 witness.

Priya Raman: Ok — summarized action items: Emily to prepare SOC2 summary + redaction plan by Apr 1; Mike to create presigned paths and set ACLs by Apr 6; Jason/Amir confirm witness window Apr 6-10 (confirmed); Alex/legal to ack NDA by Apr 2. If any of these slip, call out here and we push launch to Apr 28. :thumbsup:

Emily Chen: I will also attach the redaction checklist to MP-EVID-847 and add the expected turnaround times.

Mike Alvarez: Presign command I plan to run (for infra folks):
```
aws s3 presign s3://marketplace-evidence/acme-si-2026/report.zip --expires-in 604800
```
Will post links in the ticket when ready.

Jason Ortiz: Thanks — we'll plan internal SI ops for Apr 6 and will send the final witness participant list (IPs + emails) by Apr 3.

Alex Turner: NDA acknowledged. Legal requests a copy of the raw pen scope and any PII redaction notes before Apr 2.

Priya Raman: Great — if no further blockers I'll merge this into the launch checklist and loop in PM for announcement cadence. Please add any updates to MP-EVID-847.

Amir Qureshi: Resent NDA to legal, confirming receipt. Thanks everyone. :raised_hands:
